Title: Osney Bridge diversion Oxford
Description: Towpath closed about 150 yards before bridge. Diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road. Alternative continues via revised route.

Title: Marsh Lock Henley footbridge closure
Description: Closed for safety since May 2022. 3-mile diversion via A4155 pavements. No through access until further notice. Expected to remain until 31 January 2026, may be extended.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure
Description: Unsafe footbridge north of Sandford Lock closed April 2025. Diversion via NCN 5.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway intermittent closure
Description: Due to corrosion, walkway closed and re-routed via Abingdon town centre. Closes during high river levels and high flows, reopens when levels recede.

Title: Temple Footbridge closure near Marlow
Description: Closed since May 2023 for safety. Central span removed November 2025, beyond economical repair. Unlikely to reopen until 2028 at earliest.

Title: Bridge 142 Runnymede closure Egham
Description: Closed February 2024 due to structural damage from flooding. Diversion via A308/Runnymede Hotel area. Expected until at least 2026, possibly 2027.

Title: Bell Weir Lock refurbishment diversion
Description: Temporary diversion at Runnymede Pleasure Ground due to Bell Weir refurbishment works. Work started spring 2026, planned completion autumn 2027.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath diversion
Description: Half-mile diversion south of Goring Bridge due to eroding towpath. Funding insufficient for repairs. Unlikely to reopen until late 2026 at earliest.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Island closed to public due to diseased trees (ash dieback). Thames Path unaffected. Complex clearance work ongoing.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure Faringdon
Description: Closed March 2024 due to structural concerns. Between Rushey and Shifford locks near Buckland. Specialist survey completed but reopening date uncertain.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Left bank blocked between River Brent bridge and Brentford Marina. No official diversion. Area being redeveloped. Some sections now open.
